title: VR training & simulation
body: Immersive trainers and scenario tools where the simulation has to match reality — multiplayer training for the Marechaussee, medical demonstrations, and experiences that hold up in front of an audience.

title: AR & spatial computing
body: On-site overlays that register digital content to the real world — HoloLens with RTK GPS for centimetre accuracy, location-based AR on Visual Positioning Systems, deployed at events worldwide.

title: Digital twins & geodata
body: Spatial models wired to real data — point clouds, 360° scans, open 3DBAG buildings and geo-data — built to support real decisions, not just to look convincing.
